content_sections.heading: KGMU Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The last date to submit the KGMU Recruitment 2026 application is 28 September 2026. The completed application must reach the concerned department by 2:00 PM. The interview is scheduled for 1 October 2026, with reporting beginning at 10:00 AM. The official notification does not specify a separate application starting date.

content_sections.heading: KGMU Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: KGMU has announced 19 project vacancies. Of these, 12 vacancies are for Research Officer (Non-Medical) and 7 are for Research Co-ordinator.

content_sections.heading: KGMU Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The educational qualification differs for the Research Officer and Research Co-ordinator posts. Candidates should check the post-specific eligibility conditions before submitting the application. Candidates must have a graduate degree in any of the following disciplines: Nursing Midwifery Life Sciences Social Science Public Health Preferably, candidates should have 1 to 2 years of experience in Reproductive Health, Family Planning and Community-Based Research. The notification also requires candidates to be well-versed in using the internet and tablets, mobiles or smartphones for data collection and to have good verbal communication skills in Hindi. Candidates should have a postgraduate degree in Nursing, Midwifery, Life Sciences, Public Health or Social Science. The notification also states that candidates with GNM or ANM qualifications and relevant experience in family planning, reproductive health or hospital-based research may also be considered. Preferably, candidates should have 1 to 2 years of experience in reproductive health, family planning or community-based research. Knowledge of data collection and follow-up of study participants is desirable. Ability to use the internet and tablets, mobiles or smartphones for data collection Good computer knowledge for data recording and analysis Good verbal communication in Hindi

content_sections.heading: KGMU Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for both Research Officer (Non-Medical) and Research Co-ordinator posts is 40 years. Age will be considered as on the date of interview, which is 1 October 2026. The official notification does not specify separate age-relaxation rules.

content_sections.heading: KGMU Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: The Research Officer (Non-Medical) post offers consolidated remuneration of Rs. 25,000 per month, while the Research Co-ordinator post offers Rs. 38,000 per month. The notification states that the remuneration is a consolidated amount without any other benefits.

content_sections.heading: KGMU Recruitment 2026 Job Location
content_sections.text: The selected candidates may be assigned to KGMU Lucknow or designated district women hospitals in Uttar Pradesh. Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology, KGMU, Lucknow Veerangna Awanti Bai District Women Hospital Veerangna Jhalkari Bai District Women Hospital District Women Hospital, Sitapur District Women Hospital, Lakhimpur District Women Hospital, Shrawasti

content_sections.heading: KGMU Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The official notification specifies an interview for the recruitment process. Candidates should report for the interview from 10:00 AM on 1 October 2026. The notification does not mention a written examination or separate skill test.

content_sections.heading: KGMU Recruitment 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit the prescribed application along with the required supporting documents. Filled prescribed application form Biodata Experience certificate, if applicable Testimonials One set of self-attested photocopies of relevant documents Candidates working in Government departments or Public Sector Undertakings must produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KGMU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit the prescribed application form to the Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology, KGMU Lucknow and also send a soft copy of the application by email. Download the official KGMU recruitment notification and prescribed application form. Read the post-wise qualification and eligibility requirements carefully. Fill in the prescribed application form. Prepare the biodata, experience certificate, testimonials and self-attested copies of relevant documents. Submit the completed application to the HOD Office, Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology, KGMU, Lucknow. Ensure that the application reaches the office by 2:00 PM on 28 September 2026. Email a soft copy of the application in Word document format to [email protected] . Eligible candidates should report for the interview from 10:00 AM on 1 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: KGMU Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will not be considered. No TA or DA will be paid for attending the interview. The salary is a consolidated amount without additional benefits. Age, educational qualification and experience will be considered up to the date of interview. Government and Public Sector Undertaking employees must produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview. The posts are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Selected candidates will have no right to claim permanent employment based on this appointment.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in KGMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: KGMU Recruitment 2026 has 19 vacancies, including 12 Research Officer (Non-Medical) posts and 7 Research Co-ordinator posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for KGMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 28 September 2026. The application must reach the concerned KGMU department by 2:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for KGMU Research Officer?
faq.answer: The Research Officer (Non-Medical) post carries consolidated remuneration of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for KGMU Research Co-ordinator?
faq.answer: The Research Co-ordinator post carries consolidated remuneration of Rs. 38,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for KGMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for both posts. Age will be considered as on 1 October 2026, the date of interview.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is required for KGMU Research Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a graduate degree in Nursing, Midwifery, Life Sciences, Social Science or Public Health. One to two years of relevant experience is preferred.

faq.answer: The notification states that candidates with GNM or ANM qualification and relevant experience in family planning, reproductive health or hospital-based research may also be considered for the Research Co-ordinator post.
